page-header-text-module-scss-module__t7zYqa__dark"><h2 data-block-key="cvphw">2026 Space Agency Partners</h2></div></div></div></div></div></div><div class="content-blocks-module-scss-module__6y1zCa__container content-blocks content-blocks--default"><div class="content-blocks-module-scss-module__6y1zCa__wrapper content-blocks-module-scss-module__6y1zCa__column content-blocks-module-scss-module__6y1zCa__start content-blocks-module-scss-module__6y1zCa__middle"><div class="content-blocks-module-scss-module__6y1zCa__block content-block-0"><div class="html-block-module-scss-module__GS-vtG__container no-spacing"><div class="container-module-scss-module__GNU7ba__row "><div class="html-container-module-scss-module__MAMAVW__html-container html-block-module-scss-module__GS-vtG__content"><p data-block-key="hp800">NASA Space Apps is proud to partner with 17 Space Agency Partners from around the world to foster international collaboration by connecting cities and countries around the globe during the NASA Space Apps Challenge. Alongside NASA’s free and open data, Space Agency Partners provide additional spaced-based data for participants to use. These partnerships reflect the global nature of the NASA Space Apps Challenge and the collaborative spirit that drives innovation.</p><p data-block-key="citbe">Our 2026 Space Agency Partners are:</p></div></div></div></div><div class="content-blocks-module-scss-module__6y1zCa__block content-block-1"><div class="content-block-spacing-module-scss-module__QFKmla__md"><div class="tile-group-block-module-scss-module__AKXO7G__container"><div class="container-module-scss-module__GNU7ba__row "><div class="tile-group-block-module-scss-module__AKXO7G__tiles"><div class="cta-tile-module-scss-module__fTjuvG__container"><div class="cta-tile-module-scss-module__fTjuvG__image"><img alt="The logo for the Angola National Space Programme Management Office are the letters GGPEN in blue with a satellite circling it." loading="lazy" width="240" height="240" decoding="async" data-nimg="1" style="color:transparent" src="https://assets.spaceappschallenge.org/media/images/Angola_GGPEN_logo.2e16d0ba.fill-240x240.png"/></div><div class="cta-tile-module-scss-module__fTjuvG__text-container"><h4 class="cta-tile-module-scss-module__fTjuvG__title">Angola - National Space Programme Management Office</h4><p class="cta-tile-module-scss-module__fTjuvG__text">The Angola National Space Programme Management Office (GGPEN) was created with a simple belief: space technology should serve people. From operating the ANGOSAT-2 satellite that connects communities across Southern Africa, to using Earth observation data to support key sectors of Angola&#x27;s economy, GGPEN builds space capability that solves real problems on the ground. As the host of the SADC Regional Satellite Programme and a signatory of the Artemis Accords, Angola is committed to a future where</p><div class="tooltip-module-scss-module__pQNhgW__wrapper"><div aria-describedby="_R_s3llqav5ubplb_"><a href="https://www.ggpen.gov.ao/" class="link-module-scss-module__kwxgZq__link link-module-scss-module__kwxgZq__primary link-module-scss-module__kwxgZq__button link-module-scss-module__kwxgZq__sm link-module-scss-module__kwxgZq__after" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer noopener">Learn More<svg class="icon icon-module-scss-module__Ik2gAa__icon icon-module-scss-module__Ik2gAa__stroke undefined "><use href="/assets/sprite.svg#spaceapps/external"></use></svg></a></div></div></div></div><div class="cta-tile-module-scss-module__fTjuvG__container"><div class="cta-tile-module-scss-module__fTjuvG__image"><img alt="The logo for the Argentina Space Agency features the bold black letters “CONAE” inside the outline of a blue circle." loading="lazy" width="240" height="240" decoding="async" data-nimg="1" style="color:transparent" src="https://assets.spaceappschallenge.org/media/images/CONAE_thumbnail.2e16d0ba.fill-240x240.png"/></div><div class="cta-tile-module-scss-module__fTjuvG__text-container"><h4 class="cta-tile-module-scss-module__fTjuvG__title">Argentina - National Commission on Space Activities</h4><p class="cta-tile-module-scss-module__fTjuvG__text">The National Commission on Space Activities of Argentina (CONAE) is the agency responsible for implementing the national space program, promoting and carrying out space activities for peaceful purposes across the productive, scientific, and educational sectors, and fostering the development of innovative national technologies throughout Argentina. CONAE recognizes the importance of space outreach and capacity building and has supported the NASA Space Apps Challenge since 2021.</p><div class="tooltip-module-scss-module__pQNhgW__wrapper"><div aria-describedby="_R_s5llqav5ubplb_"><a href="https://www.argentina.gob.ar/ciencia/conae" class="link-module-scss-module__kwxgZq__link link-module-scss-module__kwxgZq__primary link-module-scss-module__kwxgZq__button link-module-scss-module__kwxgZq__sm link-module-scss-module__kwxgZq__after" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer noopener">Learn More<svg class="icon icon-module-scss-module__Ik2gAa__icon icon-module-scss-module__Ik2gAa__stroke undefined "><use href="/assets/sprite.svg#spaceapps/external"></use></svg></a></div></div></div></div><div class="cta-tile-module-scss-module__fTjuvG__container"><div class="cta-tile-module-scss-module__fTjuvG__image"><img alt="The logo for the Bahrain Space Agency features a red and gold swoosh orbiting a blue circle with a small satellite above it." loading="lazy" width="240" height="240" decoding="async" data-nimg="1" style="color:transparent" src="https://assets.spaceappschallenge.org/media/images/BSA_thumbnail2_v1UbdxF.2e16d0ba.fill-240x240.png"/></div><div class="cta-tile-module-scss-module__fTjuvG__text-container"><h4 class="cta-tile-module-scss-module__fTjuvG__title">Bahrain Space Agency</h4><p class="cta-tile-module-scss-module__fTjuvG__text">The Bahrain Space Agency (BSA) aims to position the Kingdom of Bahrain as a global player in space science to support sustainable development. BSA focuses on space technologies for national growth, promoting space research and applications, and building local capacity. The agency collaborates and partners with government entities, the private sector, and universities.</p><div class="tooltip-module-scss-module__pQNhgW__wrapper"><div aria-describedby="_R_s7llqav5ubplb_"><a href="https://bsa.gov.bh/" class="link-module-scss-module__kwxgZq__link link-module-scss-module__kwxgZq__primary link-module-scss-module__kwxgZq__button link-module-scss-module__kwxgZq__sm link-module-scss-module__kwxgZq__after" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer noopener">Learn More<svg class="icon icon-module-scss-module__Ik2gAa__icon icon-module-scss-module__Ik2gAa__stroke undefined "><use href="/assets/sprite.svg#spaceapps/external"></use></svg></a></div></div></div></div><div class="cta-tile-module-scss-module__fTjuvG__container"><div class="cta-tile-module-scss-module__fTjuvG__image"><img alt="The logo for the Brazilian Space Agency features a blue sphere with a yellow orbital swoosh alongside bold blue letters reading AEB." loading="lazy" width="240" height="240" decoding="async" data-nimg="1" style="color:transparent" src="https://assets.spaceappschallenge.org/media/images/AEB_thumbnail.2e16d0ba.fill-240x240.png"/></div><div class="cta-tile-module-scss-module__fTjuvG__text-container"><h4 class="cta-tile-module-scss-module__fTjuvG__title">Brazilian Space Agency</h4><p class="cta-tile-module-scss-module__fTjuvG__text">The Brazilian Space Agency (AEB) promotes the development of space activities to drive scientific advancement, technological innovation, and sustainable development. As a proud supporter of the NASA Space Apps Challenge, AEB values global collaboration and open innovation to engage new generations in addressing real-world challenges.</p><div class="tooltip-module-scss-module__pQNhgW__wrapper"><div aria-describedby="_R_s9llqav5ubplb_"><a href="https://www.gov.br/aeb" class="link-module-scss-module__kwxgZq__link link-module-scss-module__kwxgZq__primary link-module-scss-module__kwxgZq__button link-module-scss-module__kwxgZq__sm link-module-scss-module__kwxgZq__after" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer noopener">Learn More<svg class="icon icon-module-scss-module__Ik2gAa__icon icon-module-scss-module__Ik2gAa__stroke undefined "><use href="/assets/sprite.svg#spaceapps/external"></use></svg></a></div></div></div></div><div class="cta-tile-module-scss-module__fTjuvG__container"><div class="cta-tile-module-scss-module__fTjuvG__image"><img alt="The Canadian Space Agency logo has a red maple leaf with 3 read stars underneath it. At the bottom is the Canadian flag and the agency&#x27;s name in English and French." loading="lazy" width="240" height="240" decoding="async" data-nimg="1" style="color:transparent" src="https://assets.spaceappschallenge.org/media/images/Canada_Space_Agency_2026_logo.2e16d0ba.fill-240x240.png"/></div><div class="cta-tile-module-scss-module__fTjuvG__text-container"><h4 class="cta-tile-module-scss-module__fTjuvG__title">Canadian Space Agency</h4><p class="cta-tile-module-scss-module__fTjuvG__text">The Canadian Space Agency (CSA) promotes the peaceful use and development of space through exploration, innovation, observation, and inspiration. Proudly supporting the NASA Space Apps Challenge since 2016, the CSA believes in the transformative power of open space data, uniting innovators to tackle challenges both on Earth and throughout the universe.</p><div class="tooltip-module-scss-module__pQNhgW__wrapper"><div aria-describedby="_R_sbllqav5ubplb_"><a href="https://www.asc-csa.gc.ca/eng/" class="link-module-scss-module__kwxgZq__link link-module-scss-module__kwxgZq__primary link-module-scss-module__kwxgZq__button link-module-scss-module__kwxgZq__sm link-module-scss-module__kwxgZq__after" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer noopener">Learn More<svg class="icon icon-module-scss-module__Ik2gAa__icon icon-module-scss-module__Ik2gAa__stroke undefined "><use href="/assets/sprite.svg#spaceapps/external"></use></svg></a></div></div></div></div><div class="cta-tile-module-scss-module__fTjuvG__container"><div class="cta-tile-module-scss-module__fTjuvG__image"><img alt="The logo for the European Space Agency features a dark blue circular symbol with a small dot and the letter “e” inside, with the lowercase letters “esa” in matching dark blue to the right." loading="lazy" width="240" height="240" decoding="async" data-nimg="1" style="color:transparent" src="https://assets.spaceappschallenge.org/media/images/esa_2026_logo_thumbnail.2e16d0ba.fill-240x240.png"/></div><div class="cta-tile-module-scss-module__fTjuvG__text-container"><h4 class="cta-tile-module-scss-module__fTjuvG__title">European Space Agency</h4><p class="cta-tile-module-scss-module__fTjuvG__text">The European Space Agency (ESA) is Europe’s gateway to space. Its mission is to shape the development of Europe’s space capability and ensure that investment in space continues to deliver benefits to the citizens of Europe and the world. ESA strives to make its data and discoveries accessible to all, providing access to Earth Observation tools &amp; science mission data.</p><div class="tooltip-module-scss-module__pQNhgW__wrapper"><div aria-describedby="_R_sdllqav5ubplb_"><a href="https://esa.int" class="link-module-scss-module__kwxgZq__link link-module-scss-module__kwxgZq__primary link-module-scss-module__kwxgZq__button link-module-scss-module__kwxgZq__sm link-module-scss-module__kwxgZq__after" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer noopener">Learn More<svg class="icon icon-module-scss-module__Ik2gAa__icon icon-module-scss-module__Ik2gAa__stroke undefined "><use href="/assets/sprite.svg#spaceapps/external"></use></svg></a></div></div></div></div><div class="cta-tile-module-scss-module__fTjuvG__container"><div class="cta-tile-module-scss-module__fTjuvG__image"><img alt="The logo for the India Space Agency features an orange upward‑pointing arrow with two blue satellite‑like arms on either side of the arrow, with the agency name underneath." loading="lazy" width="240" height="240" decoding="async" data-nimg="1" style="color:transparent" src="https://assets.spaceappschallenge.org/media/images/ISRO_thumbnail.2e16d0ba.fill-240x240.png"/></div><div class="cta-tile-module-scss-module__fTjuvG__text-container"><h4 class="cta-tile-module-scss-module__fTjuvG__title">Indian Space Research Organization</h4><p class="cta-tile-module-scss-module__fTjuvG__text">The Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO) is the space agency of India. The organisation is involved in science, engineering and technology to harvest the benefits of outer space for India and mankind. ISRO is a major constituent of the Department of Space (DOS), Government of India.</p><div class="tooltip-module-scss-module__pQNhgW__wrapper"><div aria-describedby="_R_sfllqav5ubplb_"><a href="https://www.isro.gov.in/" class="link-module-scss-module__kwxgZq__link link-module-scss-module__kwxgZq__primary link-module-scss-module__kwxgZq__button link-module-scss-module__kwxgZq__sm link-module-scss-module__kwxgZq__after" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer noopener">Learn More<svg class="icon icon-module-scss-module__Ik2gAa__icon icon-module-scss-module__Ik2gAa__stroke undefined "><use href="/assets/sprite.svg#spaceapps/external"></use></svg></a></div></div></div></div><div class="cta-tile-module-scss-module__fTjuvG__container"><div class="cta-tile-module-scss-module__fTjuvG__image"><img alt="The logo for the Italian Space Agency features the letters “ASI” in dark blue with a sweeping arc forming a partial blue orbit around them, with the agency name written in Italian below." loading="lazy" width="240" height="240" decoding="async" data-nimg="1" style="color:transparent" src="https://assets.spaceappschallenge.org/media/images/Italy_Space_Agency_thumbnail.2e16d0ba.fill-240x240.png"/></div><div class="cta-tile-module-scss-module__fTjuvG__text-container"><h4 class="cta-tile-module-scss-module__fTjuvG__title">Italian Space Agency</h4><p class="cta-tile-module-scss-module__fTjuvG__text">The Italian Space Agency (ASI) is dedicated to promoting, coordinating, and advancing the national activities and contributions to the global space agenda, with a strong focus on scientific research, Earth observation, space exploration, and technological innovation. ASI believes in the power of open science and the role of global collaboration for our planet and beyond.</p><div class="tooltip-module-scss-module__pQNhgW__wrapper"><div aria-describedby="_R_shllqav5ubplb_"><a href="https://www.asi.it/" class="link-module-scss-module__kwxgZq__link link-module-scss-module__kwxgZq__primary link-module-scss-module__kwxgZq__button link-module-scss-module__kwxgZq__sm link-module-scss-module__kwxgZq__after" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer noopener">Learn More<svg class="icon icon-module-scss-module__Ik2gAa__icon icon-module-scss-module__Ik2gAa__stroke undefined "><use href="/assets/sprite.svg#spaceapps/external"></use></svg></a></div></div></div></div><div class="cta-tile-module-scss-module__fTjuvG__container"><div class="cta-tile-module-scss-module__fTjuvG__image"><img alt="The logo for the Japan Space Agency features the stylized blue letters “JAXA,” with a sharp intersecting line forming an abstract star shape for the first “A.”" loading="lazy" width="240" height="240" decoding="async" data-nimg="1" style="color:transparent" src="https://assets.spaceappschallenge.org/media/images/JAXA_thumbnail.2e16d0ba.fill-240x240.png"/></div><div class="cta-tile-module-scss-module__fTjuvG__text-container"><h4 class="cta-tile-module-scss-module__fTjuvG__title">Japan Aerospace Exploration Agency</h4><p class="cta-tile-module-scss-module__fTjuvG__text">The Japan Aerospace Exploration Agency (JAXA) promotes Earth observation, data analysis, and application research as a core agency to develop Earth observation satellites in Japan. By monitoring the Earth&#x27;s environment from space, JAXA aims to contribute to addressing global challenges.</p><div class="tooltip-module-scss-module__pQNhgW__wrapper"><div aria-describedby="_R_sjllqav5ubplb_"><a href="https://earth.jaxa.jp/en/about/index.html" class="link-module-scss-module__kwxgZq__link link-module-scss-module__kwxgZq__primary link-module-scss-module__kwxgZq__button link-module-scss-module__kwxgZq__sm link-module-scss-module__kwxgZq__after" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer noopener">Learn More<svg class="icon icon-module-scss-module__Ik2gAa__icon icon-module-scss-module__Ik2gAa__stroke undefined "><use href="/assets/sprite.svg#spaceapps/external"></use></svg></a></div></div></div></div><div class="cta-tile-module-scss-module__fTjuvG__container"><div class="cta-tile-module-scss-module__fTjuvG__image"><img alt="The logo for the South Korean Space Agency KASA has their letters with a red upward line for the top of the K culminating with a star over the first A." loading="lazy" width="240" height="240" decoding="async" data-nimg="1" style="color:transparent" src="https://assets.spaceappschallenge.org/media/images/KASA_logo_thumbnail.2e16d0ba.fill-240x240.png"/></div><div class="cta-tile-module-scss-module__fTjuvG__text-container"><h4 class="cta-tile-module-scss-module__fTjuvG__title">Korea AeroSpace Administration</h4><p class="cta-tile-module-scss-module__fTjuvG__text">The Korea AeroSpace Administration (KASA) is the national aerospace agency of the Republic of Korea and the control tower for the nation&#x27;s space, exploration, and aeronautics endeavors. Its mission is to secure innovative technologies through the development of aerospace technology, promote the aerospace industry, and implement policies and projects to protect the public from space hazards.</p><div class="tooltip-module-scss-module__pQNhgW__wrapper"><div aria-describedby="_R_slllqav5ubplb_"><a href="https://www.kasa.go.kr/eng/index.do" class="link-module-scss-module__kwxgZq__link link-module-scss-module__kwxgZq__primary link-module-scss-module__kwxgZq__button link-module-scss-module__kwxgZq__sm link-module-scss-module__kwxgZq__after" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer noopener">Learn More<svg class="icon icon-module-scss-module__Ik2gAa__icon icon-module-scss-module__Ik2gAa__stroke undefined "><use href="/assets/sprite.svg#spaceapps/external"></use></svg></a></div></div></div></div><div class="cta-tile-module-scss-module__fTjuvG__container"><div class="cta-tile-module-scss-module__fTjuvG__image"><img alt="The logo for the Nigerian National Space Research and Development Agency features a blue circle with an upward‑facing rocket in the center, and a diamond beneath it with three white stars on each side." loading="lazy" width="240" height="240" decoding="async" data-nimg="1" style="color:transparent" src="https://assets.spaceappschallenge.org/media/images/NASRDA_logo_thumbnail.2e16d0ba.fill-240x240.png"/></div><div class="cta-tile-module-scss-module__fTjuvG__text-container"><h4 class="cta-tile-module-scss-module__fTjuvG__title">Nigeria - As a proud supporter of the NASA Space Apps Challenge, the Paraguayan Space Agency champions youth participation, open innovation, and international collaboration to unlock the potential of space for national progress.</p><div class="tooltip-module-scss-module__pQNhgW__wrapper"><div aria-describedby="_R_spllqav5ubplb_"><a href="https://aep.gov.py/" class="link-module-scss-module__kwxgZq__link class="cta-tile-module-scss-module__fTjuvG__title">Spanish Space Agency</h4><p class="cta-tile-module-scss-module__fTjuvG__text">The Spanish Space Agency (AEE) believes that space has the power to improve our lives, protect our planet, and spark curiosity and innovation. That’s why they are proud to support the NASA Space Apps Challenge, a global hackathon that brings people together to address real-world problems using creativity, science, and teamwork. The Spanish Space Agency works to make space part of everyone’s future—by promoting research, supporting innovation, and encouraging young minds to explore new ideas.</p><div class="tooltip-module-scss-module__pQNhgW__wrapper"><div aria-describedby="_R_stllqav5ubplb_"><a href="https://www.aee.gob.es/" class="link-module-scss-module__kwxgZq__link link-module-scss-module__kwxgZq__primary link-module-scss-module__kwxgZq__button link-module-scss-module__kwxgZq__sm link-module-scss-module__kwxgZq__after" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer noopener">Learn More<svg class="icon icon-module-scss-module__Ik2gAa__icon icon-module-scss-module__Ik2gAa__stroke undefined "><use href="/assets/sprite.svg#spaceapps/external"></use></svg></a></div></div></div></div><div class="cta-tile-module-scss-module__fTjuvG__container"><div class="cta-tile-module-scss-module__fTjuvG__image"><img alt="The logo for the Turkish Space Agency features the bold red letters “TUA,” with the center of the “A” forming a white star, and the agency name written below." loading="lazy" width="240" height="240" decoding="async" data-nimg="1" style="color:transparent" src="https://assets.spaceappschallenge.org/media/images/Turkish_Space_Agency_thumbnail.2e16d0ba.fill-240x240.png"/></div><div class="cta-tile-module-scss-module__fTjuvG__text-container"><h4 class="cta-tile-module-scss-module__fTjuvG__title">Turkish Space Agency</h4><p class="cta-tile-module-scss-module__fTjuvG__text">The Turkish Space Agency (TUA) is a state authority which carries out the activities on law, management, etc. to support the development &amp;
